prompts: Create a new square TRANSPARENT PNG sprite atlas for Mira, using first image ONLY as canonical appearance reference, second and third as chibi size/style and motion references. Exact 4 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS, 16 equal square cells. Each cell full character, separate transparent gutters, no text/grid. Target atlas 2048x2048. Two-head-tall anime RPG healer readable at 70px. Long light lavender hair, exposed-shoulder white robe with gold trim, brown waist medicine pouches, blue-lavender ribbon, pale skin. IMPORTANT in EVERY frame: an easily recognizable GOLD CRESCENT MOON HAIR CLIP beside the white flower and dark blue ribbon on the visible side of her HEAD (not only the staff). Gentle visibly tired face: heavy upper eyelids, muted gray-violet under-eye shadows, slightly weary soft brows and small caring smile, pale cheeks. Keep her kind and trying hard, NOT angry, zombie or perpetually asleep. Match this fatigue in every pose while varying emotion. Staff has separate crescent-and-orb. All bodies face RIGHT. ROW 1: four true alternating walk phases with left leg forward, left leg passing, right leg forward, right leg passing; visibly alternating feet, same body size and foot baseline. ROW 2: four healing/casting phases: prepare staff, raise staff, extend staff right within cell, lower staff recovering. ROW 3: standing weary gentle idle; kneeling gathering a sprig; kneeling holding sprig with tired warm smile; flinch with hurt expression. ROW 4: push cargo with hands extended no staff (left foot forward); push cargo no staff (right foot forward); kneeling tying a small cloth parcel no staff; kneeling checking a blank tag on parcel no staff. No cart in push cells. Preserve outfit/hair/head ornament throughout. Clean confident outlines, broad soft shading, no glows, scenery, ground or drop shadows. Every cell has 12 percent transparent margins. Fully transparent alpha background; NO labels.

Revise this Mira sprite atlas ONLY for layout safety. Keep all 16 existing character poses, the crescent moon hair ornament and visibly tired kind eyes, outfit and painting style unchanged. Make an EXACT 4 by 4 square grid with WIDE CLEAR TRANSPARENT GUTTERS: each complete sprite including staff/hair/feet must fit inside inner 75% width and 75% height of its own equal cell, centered horizontally, feet near 85% cell height. No piece may cross a cell boundary. The casting staff in row 2 column 3 especially must remain fully inside that cell. All bodies same scale. ROW1 must show alternating walking feet: columns1/2 left foot lead/passing, columns3/4 right foot lead/passing, not four versions of the same step. Retain expression variety and crescent clip clearly visible in every cell. 2048x2048 square transparent alpha PNG, no labels or grid.
mira.notes: Runtime uses prepare / raised staff hold / idle recovery for casting to avoid neighboring sprite intrusion in the extended-staff cells. Walking uses the dedicated four-phase sheet.

walk.prompt: Edit ONLY the head details and face on this exact 2x2 walking sprite sheet. Preserve the four DIFFERENT WALKING LEG POSES, all body silhouettes, staff positions, clothing, cell layout and transparent spacing exactly as they are. In EVERY cell add a clearly visible gold CRESCENT MOON HAIR CLIP beside the flower and blue ribbon on the visible side of Mira's head, separate from the staff crescent. In every face give her visibly tired yet kind eyes: heavier upper lids, soft gray-violet under-eye shadows, pale cheeks, small gentle smile instead of energetic open mouth. Do not change the legs, feet, hands, size or body placement. Keep alternating left/right walking poses as in this input. Clean transparent alpha PNG, no glow or background.

prompts: A single compact game worksite prop for checking footprints against a trail sign in a cozy fantasy side-scrolling RPG. Isolated transparent PNG sprite. A short weathered wooden signpost with TWO SMALL opposite pointing blank arrow planks, only a simple carved leaf symbol, NO text/letters/numbers. Beside its base a very small isolated patch of warm brown dirt holding three clearly recognizable boot prints curving past the post, two small grass tufts. No crates, no bags, no boxes, no cargo, no map scroll, no large landscape. Simple clear silhouette and broad color shapes readable at 80px high, clean warm dark outlines, soft hand-painted anime shading like a small RPG prop. Three-quarter side view, restrained browns/greens. Full object centered with 12 percent transparent margin; truly transparent alpha background. Do not include solid colored backdrop, ground extending to edges, or drop shadows.

Keep this exact wooden two-way signpost and three footprints object, but REMOVE COMPLETELY all soft brown/gold/green glow, halo, vignette, shadow, and haze around the prop. The outside of the crisp object silhouette and small footprint dirt patch must be fully transparent alpha zero. Simplify bark scratches, tiny moss flecks and gravel: clean chunky painted shapes readable at 80px. Preserve blank sign planks with leaf symbols, three boot prints and two small grass tufts. True transparent PNG, no backdrop.

distribution: Lossless WebP via road-art:optimize; native images retained. The renderer caches isolated small figure frames with smooth downsampling and mipmapped filtering.
